candidate_relations.reason: The candidate correctly identifies COPD exacerbation as the precipitating cause leading to cardiac arrest (via hypoxemia), matching the etiologic and outcome components of the reference. However, the reference diagnosis explicitly requires RBBB as a key diagnostic finding supported by the ECG data (rsR' in V1, wide S waves in I and V6, prolonged r-to-peak R' time, QRS 133 ms), which is entirely absent from the candidate. The composite benchmark diagnosis is RBBB + cardiac arrest due to hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation; the candidate covers only the latter portion.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Captures the COPD exacerbation/hypoxemia etiology and cardiac arrest components but omits the Right Bundle Branch Block (RBBB) finding, which is a required component of the full benchmark diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis is a composite requiring both an ECG-based structural finding (RBBB) and a clinical etiology (hypoxemia from COPD exacerbation); candidates must address both components for complete equivalence
